full_question_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.tdocNumber AS sourceTdocNumber,c.sourceAuthoredSummary AS summary FROM CR c JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT p ON p.src_id=c.node_id JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=p.dst_id WHERE m.canonicalMeetingNumber='RAN2#132' AND c.status='agreed' ORDER BY sourceTdocNumber
original_query_sql: SELECT c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,c.summaryOfChange AS summary FROM Agreement a JOIN rel_MADE_AT am ON am.src_id=a.node_id JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=am.dst_id JOIN rel_REFERENCES ac ON ac.src_id=a.node_id JOIN CR c ON c.node_id=ac.dst_id WHERE m.meetingNumberInt=132 AND c.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
